supersession_reason: Before observing any v1 outcome, inspection of the frozen historical solver showed that its defined re-entry primitive is source re-instantiation followed by one congruence wrap. Testing instantiation alone would under-test the existing frame.
residual: A literal target endpoint is generated, but target components remain disconnected.

rivals.R1_REENTRY_CONGRUENCE_CLOSES: One lawful re-entry generation plus its defined single congruence wrap joins target components or yields replayable closure.
rivals.R2_REENTRY_DOES_NOT_ADD: Literal target endpoints cannot produce any new bounded source re-entry instances; the obstruction is not reuse.
rivals.R3_CONGRUENCE_DOES_NOT_ADD: Re-entry adds source edges, but the congruence phase adds none; ordinary chain assembly or a different composition primitive is missing.
rivals.R4_CONTEXTUAL_SUPERPOSITION_NEEDED: Re-entry and congruence both add lawful edges but still do not join target components; the next discriminator is contextual overlap/superposition of derived equalities.
rivals.R5_MEASUREMENT_ARTIFACT: No literal target RHS endpoint was actually generated.

decision_rule: Use only literal target endpoints already generated by the frozen target-narrowing parent as derived re-entry terms.
Instantiate one bounded re-entry generation using the frozen solver's instantiate_reentry routine.
Apply exactly one congruence round to those newly re-entered instances using the same derived terms as siblings.
Check target-component connectivity and shortest-path replay after each stage.
Classify by the rivals above; do not enlarge any frozen term/node/edge limit.
